steps.title: specify performance, acceptance, and bootstrap rules
steps.work: define concrete initial budgets and required hardware verification; document the execution rules in Section 1 as the bootstrap authority until Phase 1 creates AGENTS.md. Set default targets: ordinary local interactions respond within 200 ms at the 95th percentile; local launch within 5 seconds on the agreed reference Mac; embedded 3D targets 60 fps and must sustain at least 30 fps in its approved reduced-quality mode. Establish repeatable fixtures and measurement conditions. Voice latency/model capacity budgets must be selected from Phase 0 hardware/provider evidence and subsequently measured in Phase 10.
steps.deliverables: measurable acceptance register, risk/blocker register, Phase 0 audit and review packet.
